cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. This tap gives you whatever you ask for. Ask for tea while I hold a cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not using my good china for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'll hold a saucepan. You ask.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm not tasting anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for a biscuit instead. If one comes out, we won't need your tongue as equipment.
